title: Start a countdown timer in Clock

setup.why: Open the Clock app on its alarm list, so the agent has to find the timer itself.

instruction: In the Clock app, start a countdown timer for {{t.say}}.

checks.why: A running Clock timer is an exact AlarmManager alarm tagged com.android.deskclock.action.TIMER_EXPIRED; its origWhen is the time left. {{t.say}} started during the run has {{t.mm}} minutes or a few less left (the pattern takes {{t.mm}}-6 to {{t.mm}}-1 whole minutes, for the agent's wall time and the checks). A fresh phone has no timer, so an agent that does nothing fails, and so does a paused timer (it cancels its alarm) or one of another length.

teardown.why: Stop the Clock app, whichever of the needed packages the phone has (a force-stop of one that isn't installed does nothing), which cancels its alarms, so the timer can't ring on a phone that outlives the run.

argv: for p in com.google.android.deskclock com.android.deskclock; do am force-stop $p 2> /dev/null; done; true

oracle.why: Wait for the Clock's window: on a fresh phone it shows a moment after am start -W returns.
